do: On macOS ARM64, copy `blaze`, `blaze-launcher` and `blaze-fact-shim` from the release build into an installation directory. Install the Rust toolchain shelf for that build and the pinned Clang shelf. Run `uv run --frozen python -I harness/v2/real_smoke.py '{"blaze":"<installation directory>","work":"<scratch directory on disk>","tmpfs":"","modules":"<proc_macro_modules executable>","toolchain_home":"<home with the pinned nightly>"}'` before any test table or measurement. The C-backed rows require the pinned native C backend. Keep the last tree whose four rows passed as the base the measuring lane uses and name its commit.
why: Twice on 2026-11-12 a tree that built and passed its small tests failed a real project at its build scripts (the second: the embedded sandbox interposer had a RUNPATH naming blaze-cargo`s build directory after a rebuild under nixpkgs` cc wrapper, and ten of reth`s build scripts were refused): a hello-world has no build script, no proc macro and no C, and a blaze started from a build tree or under cargo is not what a user runs.
